snippet.title: Backrooms Manager Together | 6-Player Co-op Horror Launch Trailer #horror #indiegame
snippet.description:
Experience the terror of the Backrooms with your friends in Backrooms Manager Together. 

This 6-player co-op horror experience throws you into an endless nightmare where survival is the only objective. 
Are you ready for the 49-day contract?

Get the game on 
Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4895520/
